WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.throws, '') as throws,
    COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM player_award pa
  INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, '')
),
hand_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    award_count,
    CAST(award_count AS NUMERIC) / (SELECT SUM(CAST(award_count AS NUMERIC)) FROM hand_counts) as share
  FROM hand_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    award_count,
    share
  FROM hand_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(award_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM hand_shares) as average_excess
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: Blank (empty string) and missing (NULL) values in throws are treated as a single group via COALESCE, not as separate groups
Each row in player_award is counted once, even if a player appears multiple times in player_award with different awards
